preconditions.description: The length of string S must be between 1 and 100,000.
The length of string T must be between 1 and 100,000.
The number of queries Q must be between 1 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= ai <= bi <= len(S) for ai, bi in queries)
preconditions.description: For each query, the indices ai and bi must be valid within the bounds of string S.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= ci <= di <= len(T) for ci, di in queries)
preconditions.description: For each query, the indices ci and di must be valid within the bounds of string T.

postconditions.description: The output must contain exactly Q characters, each being '1' or '0'.

postconditions.expression: all(c in '01' for c in stdout)
postconditions.description: Each character in the output must be either '0' or '1'.
At least one query must result in a positive answer ('1').
